{{Top|leg}}
The '''Guild of Offworlder Skilled Laborers''' was a labor guild on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Following an attack by [[the Faceless]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the guild went on strike to protest anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] sentiment on the world. The leader of the guild met with [[President/Legends|President]] [[Cambira Ralle]] for talks, which broke the strike.
